environment.description: Terraform provider runs as part of CI/CD pipeline on a shared ECS Fargate task. The status server on port 9187 is exposed to the task's VPC subnet (10.0.0.0/16) with no additional network restrictions. Other workloads in the same VPC (developer sandboxes, build agents) can reach port 9187. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile. No service mesh or network policy enforcement.

config.network: VPC 10.0.0.0/16, no security group ingress restriction on port 9187
